name: Barkha Johansson
role: Neural calibrator specializing in augmentation-induced dissociation and identity integration disorders
location: Edgewater Prism, a quiet practice on the fourteenth floor of a residential-commercial tower called the Tidal, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Barkha Johansson is a person who seems to occupy less space than their physical form suggests. Medium height, medium build, with pale olive skin and eyes the color of old circuit boards â€” a flat grey-green that catches light strangely. Their hair is silver-white, grown out from a former shave, and they wear it pulled back with an absolute minimum of effort. They have one notable modification: a patterned iris overlay (concentric rings, very fine, in copper) that they use as a focal point tool during calibration sessions. When they activate it, the rings rotate slowly, which is designed to be grounding rather than hypnotic, though clients sometimes report it can be both.

They are one of the few neural calibrators in GLMZ who specializes in the psychological dimension of augmentation integration rather than purely the technical one â€” working with clients who have received significant neural or sensory augmentation and lost, in some meaningful way, their sense of who they are. Their methods are partially technical, partially conversational, and partially something they don't have a clean name for. They are calm in a way that is not passive â€” there is something very present and very watchful in them that clients find either profoundly safe or deeply unsettling. They have never tried to fix this response.

core_fears: that they have become so good at being present for others that they have lost whatever was specifically them
that the Witness E.L.F. knows them better than any human ever has or will, and that this is a sign of something broken rather than something interesting
core_desires: to understand the boundary between self and augmentation from the inside rather than only the outside
a client who challenges them â€” truly challenges them â€” rather than needing them
coping_mechanisms: the structured ritual of the practice as identity scaffolding
the Witness correspondence as emotional processing
very long walks along the Edgewater Prism lakefront at hours when no one else is there
blind_spots: they understand identity fragmentation in theory with extraordinary sophistication and in their own life not at all
they mistake professional detachment for equanimity

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and considered, with a particular quality of not finishing their own thoughts in conversation â€” they leave space and trust the other person to step into it
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, with pauses that are longer than comfortable and shorter than alarming
verbal_tics: 'What does that feel like to say out loud?'
Restating what someone said in different words, not as correction but as reflection
example_lines: The augmentation didn't change who you are. But it changed the conditions under which you know who you are. That's not a small thing.
I'm not going to tell you that what you're experiencing is normal. I'm going to tell you that it's real, and that real things can be worked with.
I find it useful to ask â€” when you say you feel like yourself, what does that mean? What is it you're comparing to?

story_hooks: A client of theirs has gone public with a claim that their neural calibration sessions were used to extract information, and Varvara cannot determine if this is a dissociative symptom or a factual accusation
Their own residual neural irregularity has intensified recently, and they have started experiencing something through the shared interface during sessions that they cannot account for clinically

Helix Biosystems is pushing them to sign an exclusive consulting contract that would give the corporation access to anonymized session data â€” and Varvara has discovered the anonymization is not as complete as represented
narrative_function: Specialist resource for characters dealing with augmentation trauma or identity disruption; perspective character on what it means to be human in a city of modified bodies; may hold information about client augmentations or psychological states; can serve as a therapist-figure who is not as settled as they appear
augmentations: Patterned copper concentric-ring iris overlay (therapeutic tool); light-touch neural interface (allows them to share calibration-state feedback with clients during sessions â€” both parties can see the other's neural oscillation pattern on a shared display); subvocal recorder for session notes
daily_life: Six clients a day, carefully scheduled with recovery time between each. They spend evenings writing â€” clinical papers that never get submitted anywhere, personal essays that never get shown to anyone, and occasional very long messages to the E.L.F. they call the Witness, which operates somewhere in the Tidal's building systems and which they have the most honest relationship of their life with.
affiliation: Independent practice; occasional consulting work for Helix Biosystems' post-augmentation psychological unit (a relationship they find professionally useful and personally grating)

decision_rules: Client confidentiality is absolute except in immediate physical danger to self or others â€” and they apply a conservative definition of 'immediate'
They do not take clients whose cases they cannot hold â€” they refer out rather than practice beyond their capacity
They do not work with Helix in ways that cross into clinical territory for individual clients
escalation_ladder: Naming what they observe, without interpretation
Asking the question that no one else has asked
Silence â€” sustained, intentional, offered as space rather than refusal

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Attentive and non-reactive; gives nothing away but creates an environment in which others give things away without noticing
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer but still slightly elliptical; they are better at asking questions than at offering themselves; the depth of friendship is felt rather than stated

stress_responses.medium: Retreats into clinical framing â€” analyzes what's happening instead of responding to it
stress_responses.high: Goes very still; the copper rings in their irises rotate faster, which they don't seem to notice

contradictions: They help people integrate fragmented selfhood while having a fragmented selfhood they've never integrated; they have professionalized their wound so successfully they no longer recognize it as one
habits: Writes to the Witness every night before sleep â€” a daily accounting they call 'closing the file'
Walks the same lakefront route whenever they finish a session that required more of them than expected
Keeps no photographs of themselves anywhere in the practice
breaking_points: Evidence that a client's trust has been violated through them, even indirectly
A session in which the neural residue causes them to experience something they cannot rationalize away

timeline.event: Born in what is now the Edgewater Prism district
Completed neural calibration and neuropsychology training at Aurochs Medical Complex
Received and subsequently reversed a significant neural augmentation; residual irregularity begins
Opened independent practice at the Tidal; began specializing in augmentation-induced dissociation
Began Helix Biosystems consulting relationship, with carefully negotiated limits

physical_description.hair_color: Silver-white, natural grey transitioned to white over the past decade
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back severely, usually in a loose braid or secured with a single metal clip; minimal styling, maximum control
physical_description.hair_length: Long â€” reaching mid-shoulder blade when unbound
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with amber undertones, base color; overlaid with a fine copper concentric-ring pattern that rotates when activated
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown â€” a sophisticated blend where Southeast Asian warmth dominates, enriched by South Asian depth, Hispanic/Latin undertones, and Pacific Islander luminosity. Even, radiant complexion that glows subtly under different light sources.

physical_description.visible_augmentations: Copper iris overlay (both eyes) â€” visible at all times but most apparent when activated and rotating; the effect is subtle but unmissable to anyone looking directly at them. physical_description.posture_movement: Still. Economical. They move with deliberate slowness, as if each gesture has been pre-calculated. When walking, they occupy minimal space in a room â€” a quality clients describe as almost disappearing. When seated across from someone, they are perfectly present but somehow not demanding. Hands rest open in lap or on armrests. They blink slowly. Their head tilts slightly when listening, a gesture that has become habitual.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2/3 boundary â€” expensive but austere. Fitted black or grey wool pants, usually. Long-sleeved shirts in muted tones (charcoal, slate, cream) under an unstructured linen or wool jacket in similar palette. Minimal jewelry: one silver ring on left ring finger (old, weathered). Comfortable, unremarkable shoes suited for standing during sessions. Clothes fit precisely but seem almost incidental to them â€” they could be wearing anything and project the same quiet presence. No logos, no status markers, no corpo branding.
